label: AP analyst, every country says urgent

taps.question: How clear are you on what is expected of you this week?
How supported do you feel by your manager this week?
How much do you feel part of the team this week?
How well has your training prepared you for your work this week?
How manageable is your workload this week?

conversation.text: You said expectations are unclear. What is happening?

Every country team emails saying their invoices are urgent, but last week when both Vietnam and Thailand demanded same-day payment, I didn't know which to do first and upset my lead. Because there's no set priority order, I lose time asking around and miss my daily quota by about 20 invoices some days.
What would help you set the priority order between country requests?
It would help if my lead could provide a simple priority order or designate one person to decide which country goes first.

Here is what I will tell HR: The absence of a priority order for urgent requests causes time loss and missed daily invoice quotas. [ROLE_CLARITY, WORKLOAD] "Because there's no set priority order, I lose time asking around and miss my daily quota by about 20 invoices some days."
